title: Doran tells you 'Four names went in with the last melt before the sealing,' then the wits check reveals only three: 'Corbet, Wyle, and Hann, struck last, then nothing after' — the promised count (four) doesn't match the delivered list (three).
where: The Assayer's Cot, Pennywell / 'ask for the moneyers' names'
